title: The Eagle and the Beetle

full_text:
Beside a cool mountain stream where wild plane trees offered shelter from the summer heat, A hare fled from an eagle and sought refuge with a humble dung beetle. The beetle pleaded for the hare's life, but the haughty eagle struck the beetle aside with her wing and devou.... The creatures of the field went about their daily lives according to their nature, each seeking their own advantage while keeping a vigilant watch over friends and foes alike.

As the hours passed, an unexpected turning point arose that tested their wits and character. A tense confrontation soon arose as rival desires crossed paths under the midday sun. Words were exchanged with cautious cunning, glances were measured, and each party sought to disguise their true intentions behind a veil of outward innocence.

Yet the timeless laws of nature cannot be deceived by clever words or false appearances. Natural instincts and sharp wits collided, bringing the trial to an immediate, decisive climax.  The outcome was swift and irreversible, leaving behind a lasting lesson for all who witnessed the event, proving that never despise the smallest enemy when justice is on his side.
moral: Never despise the smallest enemy when justice is on his side.
